instruction: Use the command line to resize tilearray.png to 500x500 pixels and save it as resized_square.png on the Desktop.

command: import pyautogui; import time; pyautogui.hotkey("ctrl", "alt", "t"); time.sleep(0.5);

metadata.explanation: Task requires resizing tilearray.png to exactly 500x500 pixels. The evaluator checks if the output file exists and has dimensions of 500x500 (with 5-pixel tolerance). Partial credit: 0.0 if file missing, 0.5 if file exists but wrong size, 1.0 if correct size.

Complete coverage - evaluator checks both width and height requirements from instruction
